svg.title: A complete roof system, pulled apart layer by layer
svg.desc: An exploded view of a shingle roof, bottom to top: the roof deck; metal drip edge along the eave; ice and water shield along the eave, lapping over that drip edge; synthetic underlayment over the rest of the deck; drip edge along the rake, on top of the underlayment; a starter strip at the eave; laminated shingles; a ridge vent over a slot at the peak; and ridge cap shingles over the vent. Illustration, not a photo of an actual job. Layer thicknesses are exaggerated so each one can be seen.
svg.text: HOW IT’S BUILT · THE WHOLE SYSTEM
A roof is nine parts, not one.

g.text: Plywood or OSB over the rafters
Metal, nailed to the deck first
Covers the rest of the deck
Nailed in the maker’s nailing area
Hot attic air out at the peak
Covers the vent and the peak
